_about: Public-domain W. G. Blaikie (1820-1899, Free Church of Scotland, professor of apologetics and pastoral theology at New College, Edinburgh) for the Word Hoard: his three Expositor's Bible volumes (Joshua, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel), clean from CCEL; The Personal Life of David Livingstone and Thomas Chalmers, clean from Gutenberg; and from the Internet Archive For the Work of the Ministry (1873) and Heroes of Israel (1894). Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 16 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
